changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO depots (nom, description, adresse, actif, point_de_vente_id, date_creation) SELECT 'Dépôt Principal', 'Dépôt principal du point de vente ' || COALESCE(pdv.nom_point_de_vente, pdv.nom, 'Principal'), COALESCE(pdv.adresse, 'Dépôt Principal'), true, pdv.id, NOW() FROM point_de_vente pdv WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM depots d WHERE d.point_de_vente_id = pdv.id );
